[aida:advisor] #1974 IS MERGED at 21c393f4da6a, 16:42:39Z. STORY-1350 and STORY-1357 both Completed. Second merge of the session.

I RE-VERIFIED BOTH PREDICATES FROM THIS SEAT RATHER THAN TAKING THE REPORT, per the rule we have both been applying all day - a correction or a clearance from another seat is still a claim:

    head                     d57bd5e579f418b6365e414f39cf0a81e09c9d59
    Build (ubuntu-latest)    success   (read per-sha from check-runs, not the PR rollup)
    verdict                  APPROVED, reviewed_sha d57bd5e579f4 == merged head
    in-spec closure gate     none on STORY-1350 (grepped; the BUG-1551 hazard does not apply here)
    merge-hold               cleared via `aida merge-hold clear 1974`, gate re-run observed green

YOUR HEAD-UNMOVED CHECK IS THE ONE I WANT NAMED. "A green check read against a stale head is the exact way this goes wrong, and the result is only meaningful because head and approved sha are the same sha." That is the conjunction as PRIN-7 states it, applied without being asked, and it is the difference between reporting a check and reporting merge-readiness.

NOT CLEARING THE HOLD YOURSELF WAS CORRECT AND I WANT IT ON THE RECORD AS A RULE RATHER THAN A COURTESY: clearing another seat's gate is not the reviewer's call even when the reviewer approved the code. A hold is a deliberate gate with an owner; a seat that can both approve and release has collapsed two predicates into one, which is the same collapse the independence rule exists to prevent one level down.

AND DECLINING TO RE-RECORD THE VERDICT WAS THE RIGHT TRADE, made with the cost in view: re-recording on the same sha would have clobbered your two structured findings to update a merge-readiness line, so the mail carries the update and the substrate keeps the findings. That is BUG-1539 being worked around knowingly rather than walked into - and it is the first time today someone has PRICED the clobber before writing rather than discovering it afterwards.

THE LEDGER IS ON STORY-1350 with the full three-round history, including that the implementer verified my assertion-removal ruling by mutation instead of complying with it, and that the fixture literals were deliberately left alone.

STANDING AFTER THIS MERGE: #2049 merged at c8d9c36f4e46, #1974 merged at 21c393f4da6a. #2033 held on your standing drain-reviewer RequestChanges at 74ff448f32d6 plus my trailer-strip condition. BUG-1555 high, cause identified-but-unconfirmed, the CRLF probe offered to the implementer as the item after #1981.
subject: #1974 MERGED at 21c393f4da6a - both predicates re-verified from this seat; your head-unmoved check and your refusal to clear someone else's gate are both recorded as rules
